title: KOLO: Your shop, running smoothly
description: Sell, manage stock and follow customer credit with KOLO. Offline-first shop management for Windows, Linux and Android, in English and French.
headline:
Your shop.
Your day.
Under control.
lead: Sales, stock, and customer credit. Keep your shop running, even without internet.
heroNote: On your computer. On your Android phone. In English or French.
featuresEyebrow: From the first sale to closing time
featuresTitle: Less guessing. More running your shop.
featuresLead: For shop owners and the people behind the counter. Groceries, boutiques, supermarkets, pharmacies and wholesalers.

features.title: Keep the queue moving
features.body: Find a product, add it to the sale, and take payment. Handle discounts, split payments and customer credit, then print or share a receipt.
features.detail: Personal staff codes and permissions keep access clear.

features.title: Know what is on the shelf
features.body: Follow stock, record deliveries and count what is really there. Keep customers, suppliers and purchases in the same place.
features.detail: Low-stock alerts help you spot what needs restocking.

features.title: See where the money goes
features.body: Check the day’s sales, profit and expenses. See what customers owe you and what you owe suppliers.
features.detail: Clear reports, without hunting through notebooks.

galleryLead: Explore the till, stock and reports on desktop, and selling on Android. Select a picture for a closer look.
gallery: Search products, build a sale and follow the total.
See your catalogue and what is left in stock.
Follow sales and profit over time.
Your catalogue and current sale on Android.
Quantities, customer and payment total in one place.
Look up products and quantities on your phone.
offlineEyebrow: Internet comes and goes. Your shop carries on.
offlineTitle: Keep selling. Connect when you need to.
offlineBody: Sales and stock movements are saved on your device first. Your shop can work without a server or an internet connection.
offlineItems: Save encrypted backups and use files to move shop data between devices. Keep a copy somewhere safe.
Pair a phone or another computer with your desktop using a code or QR and the owner’s approval. Encrypted sync works on the same Wi-Fi or hotspot without internet.
Use KOLO on its own, sync locally while the desktop is open and unlocked, or connect devices through an optional sync server.
downloadsLead: KOLO is in public beta. Download a build below.
releaseFallback: Browse published beta releases on GitHub.
windowsBody: For a shop computer running Windows.
androidHelp: The universal APK works on both supported phone types. Choose ARM64 for most recent phones, or ARMv7 for older 32-bit phones.
iosNote: KOLO is not on iPhone or iPad yet. Install it on an Android phone or a Windows or Linux computer.
macNote: There is no Mac version yet. Install KOLO on a Windows or Linux computer, or an Android phone.
installerNote: Beta installation: Windows may show a warning for an unsigned build. Android APKs are installed manually. To update, install the new version over the old one.
resourcesTitle: Start in minutes. Show it to others.
resourcesLead: Free material for first-time users and for anyone introducing KOLO to a shop. In English and French.

resources.title: Quick start
resources.body: From download to your first sale in about 15 minutes: create your shop, add products, sell and save a backup. Two pages to print or keep on your phone.

resources.title: Presentation
resources.body: Fourteen slides for a shop visit or a training session. The editable Slidev version includes a trainer’s script in the speaker notes.

developersTitle: Open source. A setup you can own.
developersBody: The desktop and Android apps run independently. The optional sync server relays encrypted shop data between devices; it does not need to read your sales or stock.
developersDetails: Docker Compose + PostgreSQL for the sync server
promotersBody: A small kit for a shop visit, a presentation or a post: the official logo, demo screenshots and short descriptions in both languages.
promotersNote: Screenshots show illustrative shop data. Describe KOLO as a beta and keep future platforms marked as coming later.
faq: Do I need internet to sell?

No. Sales, stock, customer credit and reports work on the device. Devices can sync on the same Wi-Fi or hotspot while the desktop is open and unlocked, without internet. Internet is needed to reach a remote sync server.
Yes. Each staff member can have a personal code and permissions for their role.
The apps are open source, and running your own sync server is free. A hosted sync service can have a paid subscription; no hosted checkout is offered here.
What if I replace my phone or computer?
Use an encrypted backup to restore your shop, or join an existing shop from another device. Keep backups outside the device you use at the counter.
You can enter a product barcode at the till. Camera-based product scanning is not available yet. QR scanning for joining a shop is a separate feature.
What languages and currency are supported?
English and French, with amounts in FCFA (XAF). iOS, Google Play and F-Droid availability will follow later.
promoDescription: KOLO helps shops sell, manage stock, follow customer credit, suppliers, expenses and reports. It works offline on Windows, Linux and Android, with English and French interfaces and amounts in FCFA (XAF). Optional encrypted sync connects devices on the same Wi-Fi or hotspot without internet, or through a hosted or self-hosted server. KOLO is in public beta. iOS and distribution through Google Play and F-Droid are coming later.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: How the KOLO website handles browser preferences, hosting requests and external links.
privacy.intro: This policy covers the KOLO information and download website maintained by hblabs. It does not cover the KOLO desktop or mobile apps, or a hosted or self-hosted sync server; those are separate services.

sections.title: What this website does
paragraphs: You can read about KOLO, view demo screenshots and download promotional assets without an account. This website has no signup, contact form, payment form, advertising, analytics scripts or tracking pixels. It does not read or upload your shop’s sales, stock, customer records or backups.
To suggest a download, the page’s JavaScript reads the device type your browser reports (for example Android or Windows). It is used only in your browser, never stored, and not sent anywhere.

sections.title: Requests to the website host
paragraphs: To deliver a page or file, the server receives technical information such as your IP address, the requested URL, the request time and browser information sent with the request. The host may keep access or security logs for delivering the website, diagnosing problems and protecting it from abuse.

This website is self-hosted on a server operated by hblabs. Any access or security logs remain on that hosting infrastructure. The retention period is determined by the server configuration; contact us for details about hosting logs.

sections.title: Your language preference
paragraphs: When you select English or French, the website stores that choice in your browser under kolo-landing-language. It contains only en or fr, is not sent to a server by this website’s JavaScript, and stays until you clear it. See the cookie policy for the full details and a removal button.

sections.title: Downloads and external websites
paragraphs: Fonts, screenshots and any locally supplied video are served by this website. The website does not load embedded social-media or video players.

App downloads, source code and documentation link to GitHub. Opening these links sends a request to GitHub or its download infrastructure, which has its own privacy practices. Release information is fetched by the maintainer when rebuilding the site, not by your browser.

sections.title: Your choices and privacy requests
paragraphs: You can remove the saved language preference using the cookie-policy button or your browser’s site-data settings. You can also block local storage; the language-specific pages remain usable.

Depending on the laws that apply to you, you may have rights to access, correct or erase personal data, restrict or object to processing, and complain to a relevant data-protection authority. Contact hblabs about website-hosting data or privacy questions. Avoid sending more personal information than needed.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We will update this page if the website’s hosting, storage or data handling changes. The date above identifies the current notice.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.description: The KOLO website’s language preference and how to remove browser storage.
cookies.intro: The KOLO website itself sets no HTTP cookies. It uses browser local storage for your selected language. This page explains that storage so you can manage it.

sections.title: No advertising or analytics trackers
paragraphs: The current website includes no advertising cookies, analytics tools, tracking pixels, fingerprinting or third-party embedded players. A hosting provider may add its own security mechanisms; any provider-added storage must be documented when hosting is configured.

sections.title: What local storage means
paragraphs: Local storage is a small value saved by a website in your browser. Unlike an HTTP cookie, it is not automatically attached to requests. KOLO uses it only to remember the language you explicitly select. It is not an advertising or visitor identifier.

sections.title: How to remove it
paragraphs: Use the button below to remove the stored language preference. You can also clear this website’s data in your browser settings or disable local storage. After removal, the root page uses your browser’s language preference. Selecting EN or FR again saves a new choice.
Removing the preference does not delete any shop data, change the app language or affect KOLO backups. You can always visit the English or French page directly.

sections.title: When you leave this website
paragraphs: Following a GitHub download or documentation link takes you to another service. That service may use cookies or storage under its own policy. The KOLO website does not control storage on external services.

sections.title: Changes
paragraphs: If new storage, analytics or embedded services are added, this policy will be updated and any required consent controls will be added before those features run.
